recentItems.title: Elmo’s Big Day of Fun! | Takalani Sesame
recentItems.description:
Join Elmo and all of his favourite friends for an exciting learning adventure! In this video, kids will discover beautiful world traditions and see how family trees can connect people living in different parts of the world. When big or nervous feelings arise, Cookie Monster and the crew show us how to pause, stand steady, and use a breathing technique to help shake those prickly feelings away.

The fun continues as the gang works together to share their individual styles and create a brand-new dance routine. Plus, Grover leads a fun math adventure all about measuring width from side to side using your very own feet! Finally, we learn the importance of caring for our community by working as a team to clean up the park, plant trees, and remember to always ask a trusted grown-up for safe drinking water when we feel thirsty.

recentItems.title: 🔴 Play & Grow with Elmo and Friends! | Takalani Sesame
recentItems.description:
Welcome to the official home of big feelings, bright ideas, and community adventures! Join Elmo, Grover, Kami, and all your favourite furry friends as we explore what makes every one of us completely special.

In this video, our friends learn how to turn everyday items into amazing treasures, like recycled cardboard houses, homemade wind chimes, and tin can music makers.

Then they discover helpful techniques like "belly breathing" and "moving it out" to manage big emotions like nervousness or excitement. And so much more! Whether we are singing new songs, playing soccer, or learning from special guests, everything is better when we do it together as a team.

Our channel is a joyful space for young explorers to learn, grow, and play every single day. On Takalani Sesame Explorers, children can dive into a world filled with fun. Like and subscribe to our channel today for new educational and fun videos every week!

recentItems.title: The Case of the Big Feeling! | Takalani Sesame
recentItems.description:
Welcome to Big Feelings Explorers, the perfect place for young adventurers to learn all about their emotions! Big feelings happen to everybody, and on this channel, we explore how they look, how they make us feel, and how they are completely okay.

Join your furry friends like Cookie Monster as they go on exciting adventures, put on plays, and surprise one another. Whether you are feeling so happy and bouncy that you cannot stay still, or you are looking for simple ways to calm down, like counting to five, we are here to help you understand your emotions.

Like, and subscribe to get new videos every single week, and let's explore our big feelings together!

recentItems.title: Staying Healthy and Speaking Up with Elmo! | Takalani Sesame
recentItems.description:
Join Elmo, Zoe, Kami, and all their wonderful friends in this fun-filled compilation as they explore important lessons about health, bodies, and community. From visiting the clinic to playing games together, the friends learn how taking care of themselves and speaking up makes everyone happier and safer.

First, Elmo feels a little nervous about going to the health clinic for his checkup. Thankfully, Miss Fatima and his friends show him that clinics are safe places where caring health workers help us stay strong and measure how much we are growing. The friends also learn all about how vaccines work to protect us from germs, discovering that a tiny pinch keeps us safe for a very long time.

Later, the friends practice using their voices to express how they feel. When a game makes someone feel uncomfortable, they learn that our bodies belong to us, and it is always okay to speak up and set boundaries.

recentItems.title: Turtle Overcomes Fear at his Big Show! | Takalani Sesame
recentItems.description:
Join Basma and Jad as the Big Feelings Explorers answer a special alert. Their friend, Turtle, is feeling a very big emotion right before he is supposed to go on stage for the big show. The friends help Turtle understand that he is feeling afraid because of a strange noise he heard.

Everyone feels fear sometimes, and it is completely normal. Basma and Jad show Turtle how he can move his body to help manage his fear and feel a little better.

This video helps young children identify the feeling of fear and understand that it is a natural emotion. Like and subscribe for more exciting videos just like this one!

recentItems.title: Celebrating Grandmothers with Elmo & Grover! | Takalani Sesame
recentItems.description:
In this exciting compilation, join Elmo, Zuzu, Grover, and friends as we celebrate the importance of grandmothers through fun adventures, teamwork, and big feelings. This video features Kamu and his precious ouma, with Elmo and Zuzu creating a vuvuzela to thank him; Autumn’s heartwarming quest to deliver a special muffin treat to her grandma; and Grover’s Big Surprise, where the Big Feelings Explorers help him process his emotions after a surprise visit from his grandmother.

recentItems.title: Elephant’s Big Brave Moment! | Takalani Sesame
recentItems.description:
In this video, The Big Feelings’ Explorers help their friend, Elephant, who feels fearful! First, as Jad and Basma are playing in the garden, Jad becomes fearful when he sees a ladybug. Then they receive an alert that Elephant is feeling fearful!

Elephant has always wanted to go down the slide, but as she is at the top, she becomes fearful. Though with the help of her furry friends, she learns that she is having a big feeling and that it is okay to feel fearful; we shouldn’t let it stop us from doing what we’ve always dreamed of doing.
